snippet.title: Silly Sausage Buffet - WISHLIST NOW!
snippet.description:
Its finally time for Nitrome Classics #2 Silly Sausage Buffet, the worlds most stretchy dog! 

Navigate this surreal platformer using unique elastic controls. Stretch and weave your way through this doggy dream trilogy of edible delights. With challenges only made possible through elasticated gameplay. A full three course gaming meal awaits!

Wishlist Silly Sausage Buffet on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3465070/Silly_Sausage_Buffet/
